//: What time the world is looked at, not what time the world plays. The hours a matchday's windows go out are rules of the game and live in CompetitionRules; these are the three moments this process wakes up to ask the calendar whether anything is due.

World.//Moving a world by hand: There is no speed setting here and there is no anchor: a matchday is a day, the championship's window goes out at fifteen hundred and the cup's at twenty-one hundred, and a season is thirty-four days from its first day to its rest day. A world that wants to be walked a day at a time instead of waited for is walked with POST /world/advance on the API, which plays the next window of the calendar — the next day, or that day's cup leg, or the close of the season and the opening of the next one — and asks nothing about the date.
